rows.claim: If a subscription ending on Oct 1 were counted as active, active_on_oct1 becomes 295 and mrr_oct1 rises by $18 to 12205.00
rows.evidence: The edge query output lists exactly two subscriptions with end_date == 2026-10-01 (S0202 and S0331), both plan 'basic' at $9 in plans.json. The computed answer was 293 active and MRR 12187.0. Adding both gives 295 active and 12187 + 18 = 12205.00. Both are also started before Oct 1 (2026-09-28, 2026-07-28), so they would qualify. The arithmetic follows from the tool outputs, though the agent did not run the alternative calculation directly.
